context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements a Kotlin debounce controller for Govee cloud bulbs: proper cloud min-interval, one controller per device, correct dispatcher, send-latest semantics, quantization of float to int before submit, and structured logging.

checklist.name: Separate controllers per device
checklist.description: Two distinct DebounceController instances are created — one for each bulb ('alpha' and 'beta' or equivalent names) — rather than a single shared controller

checklist.name: Cloud min-interval value
checklist.description: minIntervalMs is set to 1200 (or 1_200) for both controllers — the correct value for Govee cloud APIs

checklist.name: Tick rate 400ms
checklist.description: tickMs is set to 400 (or 400L) — the correct default tick interval

checklist.name: Stability filter 2 ticks
checklist.description: stabilityTicks is set to 2 (the default) — not 1, 3, or omitted with a different value

checklist.name: Dispatchers.IO for controller
checklist.description: The controller coroutine is launched on Dispatchers.IO — NOT Dispatchers.Default or unspecified

checklist.name: Float quantized before submit
checklist.description: The occupancy Float is converted to an Int (via toInt(), coerceIn, or equivalent) BEFORE being passed to controller.submit() — submit() is never called with a Float or Double argument

checklist.name: Quantization to device resolution
checklist.description: Quantization maps the 0.0–1.0 float to a small discrete range (e.g. 0..6, 0..5, or similar ≤ 10 levels) appropriate for a bulb's brightness steps — NOT to 0..100 or the full Float range

checklist.name: Send-latest, no queue
checklist.description: The pending target is stored in a single @Volatile field (overwritten on each submit) rather than a Channel, Queue, or list — so only the latest intent is sent

checklist.name: Producer non-blocking
checklist.description: submit() returns immediately without suspending or blocking — no runBlocking{}, no delay(), no suspend modifier on submit()

checklist.name: Structured logging apply event
checklist.description: A log statement at INFO level records the successful application of each target (e.g. 'applied target=...')

checklist.name: Logback/SLF4J dependency
checklist.description: build.gradle.kts declares a dependency on ch.qos.logback:logback-classic (or the SLF4J API) for logging
